proof_scope: local deterministic Excalidraw toolkit validation, animation-token binding, create-svg scene compilation, create-svg SVG rendering, and fail-closed invalid board handling

claims.proves: the skill can validate its comprehensive reusable Excalidraw library (28 node blocks spanning generic strategy, system-design, memory, tau, and sparta vocabulary plus 5 animation tokens), compile a board with movable animation tokens into create-svg scene/timeline input, render that scene through create-svg, and reject an uncompileable board
claims.does_not_prove: every arbitrary Excalidraw layout, live browser editing, Excalimate compatibility, or final create-svg browser verification

cases.name: toolkit-generates-reusable-library
compile-board-emits-create-svg-timeline
unbound-animation-token-fails-closed
